title: author-loop
objective: Author a playable mini-story in the Studio without touching JSON, play it, hit a wrong gate, edit, continue the same chat — including an invalidating edit that goes through the choice popup. Includes one author-view driver pass (Probe + Nudge).

checks.goal: the Studio opens on an empty draft and offers every authoring surface
roster members can be authored in the Studio UI

steps.eval: const s = globalThis.storyOrchestratorStudioDraft.getState(); s.mutate((d) => ({ ...d, roster: [{ id: 'guide', name: 'Arin' }] })); return s.draft.roster;

checks.goal: story identity, requirements, dramatic shape and thread bridges are authorable
a story keeps one identity across edits, so re-selecting hydrates instead of forking a new record

steps.eval: const rt = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime; const before = rt.getSnapshot(); if (!before.storyId) throw new Error('no story id after import'); const response = await fetch('/scripts/extensions/third-party/story-orchestrator/examples/sun-ruins/quest-for-the-sun-ruins.json'); const story = await response.json(); story.description = 'Edited by journey J2.'; await rt.importStory(JSON.stringify(story)); const after = rt.getSnapshot(); if (after.storyId !== before.storyId) throw new Error(`identity forked: ${before.storyId} -> ${after.storyId}`); const records = after.library.filter((record) => record.id === after.storyId); if (records.length !== 1) throw new Error(`library forked into ${records.length} records`); return { storyId: after.storyId, libraryVersion: records[0].version, identity: after.storyIdentity };

checks.goal: the drawer's author view opens the Studio on the story this chat is playing

steps.eval: await new Promise((done) => setTimeout(done, 500)); const modal = document.getElementById('so-studio-modal'); if (!modal) throw new Error('Edit story did not open the Studio'); const title = modal.querySelector('input[aria-label="Story title"]').value; if (title !== 'Quest for the Sun Ruins') throw new Error(`Studio opened on the wrong story: ${title}`); const id = globalThis.storyOrchestratorStudioDraft.getState().draft.id; if (id !== 'sun-ruins') throw new Error(`Studio draft is not this chat's story: ${id}`); return { title, id };

checks.goal: playing, then saving a compatible edit from this chat keeps the run going (hot-swap, not reset)

steps.send: Arin taps the notice board. "That one. The Sun Ruins."

steps.eval: const before = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime.getSnapshot(); globalThis.__j2Boundary = before.boundary; globalThis.__j2Blackboard = JSON.stringify(before.blackboard); return { boundary: before.boundary };

const store = globalThis.storyOrchestratorStudioDraft.getState(); store.mutate((d) => ({ ...d, description: 'Edited mid-play by journey J2.' })); return { dirty: globalThis.storyOrchestratorStudioDraft.getState().dirty, id: store.draft.id };

const after = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime.getSnapshot(); if (after.boundary < globalThis.__j2Boundary) throw new Error(`hot-swap reset progress: ${globalThis.__j2Boundary} -> ${after.boundary}`); if (JSON.stringify(after.blackboard) !== globalThis.__j2Blackboard) throw new Error('hot-swap lost blackboard values'); return { boundary: after.boundary, storyIdentity: after.storyIdentity };

checks.goal: an invalidating edit asks first: keeping progress drops only what no longer fits

steps.eval: globalThis.storyOrchestratorStudioDraft.getState().mutate((d) => ({ ...d, qualities: [...d.qualities, { key: 'j2_probe', type: 'string', source: 'extractor', rubric: 'Journey J2 probe value.' }] })); return { added: 'j2_probe' };

const snapshot = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime.getSnapshot(); if (snapshot.blackboard.j2_probe !== 'carried') throw new Error(`probe value did not land: ${JSON.stringify(snapshot.blackboard.j2_probe)}`); globalThis.__j2Boundary = snapshot.boundary; return { boundary: snapshot.boundary, j2_probe: snapshot.blackboard.j2_probe };

const snapshot = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime.getSnapshot(); if ('j2_probe' in snapshot.blackboard) throw new Error('orphaned value survived the update'); if (snapshot.boundary < globalThis.__j2Boundary) throw new Error('invalidating keep-playing reset the run'); return { boundary: snapshot.boundary, dropped: globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime.getLastStoryUpdate().dropped };

checks.goal: cancelling an invalidating edit leaves the chat on its pinned version, library still saved

steps.eval: const active = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime.getSnapshot().activeCheckpointId; globalThis.__j2Active = active; globalThis.storyOrchestratorStudioDraft.getState().mutate((d) => ({ ...d, checkpoints: d.checkpoints.filter((c) => c.id !== active), transitions: d.transitions.filter((t) => t.from !== active && t.to !== active) })); return { active };

const snapshot = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime.getSnapshot(); if (snapshot.activeCheckpointId !== globalThis.__j2Active) throw new Error(`cancel still moved the chat: ${snapshot.activeCheckpointId}`); if (!snapshot.storyIdentity.drifted) throw new Error('library edit was not saved (nothing to drift from)'); return { activeCheckpointId: snapshot.activeCheckpointId, identity: snapshot.storyIdentity };

checks.goal: the in-play author driver still works in author view (Probe + Nudge, real model)

steps.eval: globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime.setUiSettings({ authorView: true }); globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime.setCopilotSettings({ enabled: true }); return true;

checks.prompt: Could you author a playable checkpoint — quality, gate, transition, cast, requirements — without opening a JSON editor?
checks.anchors: 1 = impossible without JSON · 3 = possible but I had to work around gaps · 5 = everything the story needed was authorable

checks.prompt: After you edited the story mid-play, did the running chat behave the way you expected — including when it asked you to choose?
checks.anchors: 1 = lost my progress · 3 = confusing but recoverable · 5 = exactly as expected
